## Summary

**Clean pass: 0 Critical, 0 Major, 0 Minor, 0 cross-remit.** I wrote the marker.

- **Tree check:** the HEAD tree matched `7d0f785e…`. No files had uncommitted changes, and the definition was unchanged.
- **Scope:** incremental, starting from my own clearance at `eb718fa` (`member-clearance`). The only file in this round's change is `frontend/app/pages/index/tests/page.stories.tsx`, at lines 28-31: the new `getByText(\`Welcome to ${common.meta.siteName}\`)` assertion. I had already cleared the two `common.ts` key changes in an earlier round.
- **Open ledger entries:** none. There is no rerun file for this audit key.
- **The new assertion does catch a broken nested reference.** `getByText` matches the whole text exactly. If the `$t(meta.siteName)` nesting breaks, the page renders the key text, so the match misses and the test fails. The h1 shows only the site name, so it can't satisfy the match by accident. The comment above the assertion explains why the expected text is spelled out instead of built with `t('welcome')`, so it passes `.claude/rules/code-comments.md`.
- **Specialists:** I ran two: React Patterns & Accessibility, and TypeScript & Architecture. Both returned results, and neither fell back to an inline review. I skipped the Translation specialist because the story has no `useTranslation` or `t()` call.
- **Specialist candidates I dropped after checking them:**
  - The hardcoded `Welcome to ` prefix (line 30). Spelling out the expected text is intentional; building it from `t('welcome')` would make the test circular.
  - The missing "one `main`" play assertion. The `main` element lives in `frontend/app/components/layout/index.tsx`, not on the page, so that assertion would fail when the page renders alone in a story.
  - A missing keyboard path for the theme switch, splitting the story into one per behavior, and the variable name `button` (line 57). All three are on lines I cleared in an earlier round, not in this round's change, and none point...
